input.expression: const s=document.querySelectorAll('select');s[0].value='Tents';s[1].value='0';s[2].value='price-asc';s.forEach(x=>x.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})));const c=document.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]');if(c.checked)c.click();document.querySelector('button').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800));let out=[document.body.innerText.split('Apply filters')[1]];const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>/^\d+$/.test(b.textContent.trim()));for(let i=1;i<btns.length;i++){[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==String(i+1)).click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800));out.push(document.body.innerText.split('Apply filters')[1]);}return out.join('\n---\n')
